venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: Calm Wednesday at Close Company Atlanta. Opening bartender had a few HH guests with table-side service. About 5 kickball teammates showed up and used their discounts; mostly returning faces from the area. Opener left around 9pm. Very quiet close to the night. Missed target by −47.5% ($941 vs $1,791). Food $202. Comps $65.25. 40 guests / $23.53 GCA. 86: coke, diet coke, sprite. MOD: MKZ/JK. Entered by Mya. Highlight: introducing regulars to a new spirit for the Adventure Gimlet — versatile cocktail to highlight.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Partly cloudy, cleared up through the night
venues.narrative: Slow start, picked up around 9pm. Some guests disappointed by limited food options — recovered by explaining what's coming and offered free popcorn (well received). One guest opened with 'I don't tip' — got the same great service regardless. A mix of interesting Wednesday folks. Missed target by −21.7% ($1,291 vs $1,649). Food $4 (continued food-sales softness — 6th day under $130). Comps $0. ~41 guests / $30.73 GCA. MOD: MD. Entered by JO. Highlight: free burger from Charmers.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: Surprisingly busy Wednesday after a rainy/gloomy start. Initially looked slow with a thin book, but built into a busy evening as the sun went down — beat yesterday's cover count within 3 hours of walk-ins. Net (excl events) $7,970.67 vs target $8,134.54 (−2.0%). Including events $11,497.67 (+41.3%). Segments: DC/AM $967.25, D&C PM $7,003.42, 6A NA. Food $1,754 / Food incl events $5,574. Comps $299.70 / 3.76%. 192 guests. **Event**: Day 2 of Omada Health — 19 breakfast / 10 day guests in Vauxhall ($3,820 event food / $3,527 net event sales); Day 3 tomorrow. AM MOD: Maggie. PM MOD: Elio & Archer. DC/AM: deep-cleaned steam wands, fresh teas brewed; low on kombucha and miso sesame, awaiting Rishi delivery. Kitchen: easy prep day, 86 salmon/olive halves/parsley. Highlight: Elio + Sud + Lily turned around a tough date-night experience (sound + table quality complaints) into a complete tone change — both Elio and Lily pushed through stomach bug to deliver service.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: Solid Wednesday with 'old school energy' — lots of two-three rounds, intensive experiences, witty banter, and a bar top that was full at midnight. Aside from a lull, about as solid as a date night could be. Could have pushed a few duos harder/faster to avoid reshuffles — worth pushing earlier on busier nights. Beat target by +44.0% ($5,787 vs $4,020). Food $536, Bev $5,252. Comps $233.53 (some DNLs, lots of popcorn and service-improvement snaquiris). 148 guests / $39 GCA. 5 solos, 4 large parties, 2 investor cocktails. Top sellers: First Time Listener, Masari, Buckhorn Exchange. Back-catalog banger: Soul Stirrer (rum sazerac). **No-shows**: Todd Petersen (2) at 9:30pm — later messaged saying they'd emailed yesterday to cancel. Glassware: 2 candle votives, 1 mixer, 1 lemon Cheater (need backup tomorrow). Maintenance: bar lights. MOD: Cara & Steeves. Door: HP. Entered by Thomas. Highlight: hosting birthday celebrations including welcoming Stilo (Milagro ambassador), Laura Toth, and Thomas's roommate Lexi visiting with her parents.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: Steady Wednesday night. Started with 33 covers and a nice presence of walk-ins shortly after open. Lots of small parties tonight, not a lot of large parties. Room gradually filled, peaking around 8:30pm and staying steady for a couple hours. Slowed around 11pm — Jaz cut around 11:30pm. A few parties in the final hour made for a smooth last call. Missed target by −14.4% ($4,476 vs $5,230). Food $904 (solid). Comps $94 (Jose regular, Mike's friends, investor, DNL). 115 guests / $38.92 GCA (Typeform reported $84.45 — likely data-entry error). 86: hamburger buns. **Maintenance/smell**: new scent diffusers worked well — didn't need to light incense throughout the night. MOD: Joe + Vic. Entered by Joe. Highlight: regular Jose dropped off dozens of pastries for the staff — wonderful surprise.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: Slower night — rain meaningfully impacted foot traffic. Apart from the reservations, not much action until around 9pm. By 9:30 a decent push of walk-ins came in escaping the rain — room filled quickly but energy didn't last; by 11:30 most had closed out. Missed target by −44.8% ($2,699 vs $4,887). Food $361. Voids $14, Comps $47. 66 guests (46 walk-ins, 20 resos) / $40.89 GCA (typeform reported $41.53). New hire Mariah onboarded and spent time with Tyler before being cut at 7. Bar team cleaned behind the bar; MOD worked on decluttering the back hall and breaking down recycling. Kitchen: decent sales for the volume — sold both orders of oysters. **Maintenance/Urgent**: recycling dumpsters overflowing (recycling not taken out for 2 days); 1st bathroom sink slow drip can't be turned off; 2nd bathroom OOO; 2 mixing glasses exploded in Jada's hand coming out of the freezer. MOD: Cory. Entered by Cory. Highlight: ABK ABK ABK.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Rainy/overcast morning, warm and sunny by afternoon
venues.narrative: Steady, run-of-the-mill Wednesday. Unusually slow morning — likely the rain. Berry completed her final day of training, took the lead on most tables, did a great job; team used downtime productively for inventory counts and side work. Slow start to the evening with a quiet happy hour; business came in waves — by 6:30 most dining-room tables were sat, then quiet again around 7:30 (cut down to 2 servers). Tiny pop right after 8:00, mostly drinks. One group of 9 had a small last push for the kitchen; only a few cocktails between 10–11; all guests out by 11:05. Decent walk-in volume from afternoon check-ins. Missed target by −31.8% ($5,528 vs $8,100). Food $2,298. Comps $177.75. Sales mix: AM bar $662, PM bar $4,691, Sun Club $175, Hot Eye $0. Sun Club: Sofia held it down most of the day, hotel guests around 1pm, no business after 3:30. Hot Eye closed. Smooth, easy kitchen service. Morning MOD: Gabby & Lex. Evening MOD: Justin & Sukru. Entered by Justin. Highlight: members from a 25-person brunch group (a few weeks ago) came back for dinner and cocktails.
